text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot per injected unit (Primary, Solar farm D, E, or F, path seed, and case; constant paths excluded). x: path error when the injection is added to the semi-synthetic baseline. y: path error when it is added to the real series and the fit without the injection is subtracted. Dashed line: equal errors. Smaller is better on both axes; dots below the line score better on the real series.'
text.tspan: One dot per injected unit (Primary, Solar farm D, E, or F, path seed, and case; constant
paths excluded). x: path error when the injection is added to the semi-synthetic baseline.
y: path error when it is added to the real series and the fit without the injection is
subtracted. Dashed line: equal errors. Smaller is better on both axes; dots below the line
score better on the real series.
